question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Lumber has many ______ beyond home building.
solution:
The correct answer is ** "uses."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Uses"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It refers to the various purposes or applications of lumber, beyond just building homes. (किसी वस्‍तु का प्रयोग (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रयोग में लाने या उसके प्रयुक्त होने का कार्य))
 
 
• Example: *The **uses**__ of computers are now widespread.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Lumber has many __**uses**__ beyond home building. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"trunks"**, refers to the main stem or body of a tree, which is used to make lumber, but does not encompass all the possible uses of lumber. (वृक्ष का तना)
 
• Option 2, **"loses"**, is a verb meaning to suffer a loss or be deprived of something, and does not fit the context of the sentence. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) खो देना, न पा सकना)
 
• Option 3, **"pluses"**, is a noun meaning advantages or positive aspects, but does not fit the context of the sentence as well as **"uses".** (स्थिति में लाभ की बात)
